name: prototype
title_zh: 先问设计问题再动手写代码的一次性原型
tagline_zh: 想验证状态模型对不对、界面长啥样，又不想被正式代码拖住？这个 Skill 只搭能回答问题的临时原型，答完就扔。
tagline_en: Sanity-check a state model or UI look without committing to real code. Builds a minimal runnable mock, answers.
desc_en: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
why_zh: 它把「验证想法」和「正式实现」彻底分开，用最小成本换取设计判断，避免在错误方向上写出一堆废代码。
why_en: Separates design validation from implementation, forcing you to learn cheaply before investing in the wrong architecture.
limit_zh: 只产出可运行的临时原型，不含测试、文档、错误处理或部署配置；不接数据库和外部服务，超出交互逻辑验证范围的部分需自行扩展。
limit_en: Outputs a runnable prototype only: no tests, docs, error handling, deployment, DB, or external services. Beyond UI/logic checks, extend yourself.
title_en: Throwaway prototype to answer one design question
